question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

Never teach your children to __flout__ the rules and regulations of their educational institution.
solution:
The correct answer is **4) Mock.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word** "flout"** means **to openly disregard or show contempt for something, especially rules or regulations.** It implies intentionally violating or disrespecting established norms.

 
 
• Example sentence: He was suspended from school for **flouting **the dress code policy.
